title: SIRESITA | Destination Recommendation System for North Sumatra
description: Capstone project focusing on building a tourism recommendation system for North Sumatra using two core machine learning techniques: Content-Based Filtering (CBF) and Collaborative Filtering (CF). The models were developed from scratch using TensorFlow and Scikit-learn, without relying on pretrained APIs or external services.
longDescription:
SIRESITA is a comprehensive tourism recommendation platform designed to promote tourism in North Sumatra. It solves the problem of 'choice overload' for tourists by providing personalized destination suggestions. 

The system utilizes a hybrid approach: 
1. **Content-Based Filtering**: Recommends places similar to what a user has liked before based on metadata (tags, categories, location). 
2. **Collaborative Filtering**: Suggests places popular among users with similar taste profiles.

The application is fully responsive and features a map-based exploration mode, detailed destination pages, and user reviews.

The AI uses a RAG system to answer specific gardening and internship questions based on a curated knowledge base. longDescription:
**Manggrow Web Platform** is a comprehensive ecosystem designed for both plant enthusiasts (gardeners) and administrative teams managing internships.

The platform solves the problem of scattered information and manual tracking by providing:
1. **Smart Garden Helper (AI Chatbot)**: 24/7 consultation with an AI Assistant powered by a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system. Users can ask about plant problems, care tips, and fertilizer recommendations.
2. **My Plants Dashboard**: Track and manage your plant collection with photos, species information, and growth notes.
3. **Automated Reminders**: Never forget watering or fertilization schedules with intelligent automated reminders.
4. **Admin Analytics Dashboard**: Monitor user growth, popular plant trends, and content performance through visual charts (Pie, Bar, Line).

**n8n Workflow Architecture:**

The application features a modern, responsive React UI with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Radix UI components, and real-time data integration using TanStack Query.

title: YOLOv11 & DeepSORT Speed Estimation | Real-Time Traffic Analytics
description: A high-performance computer vision application for analyzing traffic flow in real-time. Combines state-of-the-art YOLOv11 object detection with DeepSORT tracking to estimate vehicle speeds from video feeds. Built from scratch with custom PyTorch implementations of YOLOv11 architecture and DeepSORT tracking algorithms, demonstrating deep understanding of modern CV pipelines.
longDescription:
**YOLOv11 & DeepSORT Speed Estimation** is a comprehensive traffic analysis platform that bridges the gap between research notebooks and production-ready applications.

What makes this project unique is the **"From Scratch"** implementation approach. Instead of relying on opaque high-level libraries, the core logic for the **YOLOv11 Model Architecture** (C3K2, SPPF, PSA blocks) and **DeepSORT Tracker** has been extracted from research notebooks and re-engineered into a clean, modular Python codebase served via a modern web API.

**The system features a dual-stage AI pipeline:**
1. **Detection & Classification**: Custom PyTorch-based YOLOv11 implementation detects vehicles (cars, motorcycles, trucks) with high precision using advanced architectural components.
2. **Tracking & Speed Estimation**: DeepSORT algorithm maintains persistent IDs across frames using Kalman Filters and Hungarian matching. Speed is calculated through pixel displacement analysis with perspective correction calibration.

**Key capabilities include:**
- **For Traffic Engineers**: Real-time speed monitoring, traffic flow analysis, automated violation detection, and comprehensive analytics dashboards.
- **For Researchers**: Transparent, modular implementation showcasing how raw tensor manipulations translate to production pipelines.
- **Video Processing**: Automatic FFmpeg transcoding ensures H.264/AAC encoding for seamless browser playback.

The application features a modern Next.js 14 UI with drag-and-drop video upload, real-time processing status updates via polling, and side-by-side comparison of original vs analyzed footage. The backend uses FastAPI for high-performance async video processing.

title: InsightSphere | Enterprise Finance AI RAG System

longDescription:
**InsightSphere** is a comprehensive financial intelligence platform that transforms static financial reports into interactive knowledge bases through advanced RAG technology.

The system enables analysts to chat directly with uploaded documents, asking specific questions like "What is the Q2 Year-over-Year growth?" and receiving answers cited from the source. It implements a sophisticated multi-persona AI system, allowing users to switch between **Consultant**, **Neutral**, and **Casual** modes for tailored responses.

**The platform features a dual-layer architecture:**
1. **Ingestion Engine**: Documents are parsed (PDF, Docx, PPTX, Excel), split into semantic chunks, embedded using sentence-transformers, and stored in ChromaDB for O(1) retrieval.
2. **RAG Inference Core**: User queries are embedded, top-k relevant chunks are retrieved from the vector store, and fed into Groq Llama-3 for ultra-fast, context-aware response generation.

**Key capabilities include:**
- **For Analysts**: Intelligent document chat with source citations, multi-format support (PDF, Excel, PPTX, Docx), persona-based AI responses, and automated report export to PowerPoint/Excel.
- **For Administrators**: Real-time system health monitoring (LLM API, Vector Store, Backend), vector database management, pre-warm embeddings, document chunk oversight, and secure local deployment via Docker.

The application features a modern React + TypeScript UI powered by Vite, with TailwindCSS for styling and Lucide icons. The backend uses FastAPI for high-performance async API serving with LangChain orchestration.

title: DERMA-DFU.ID | AI-Powered Diabetic Foot Ulcer Triage System
description: A comprehensive medical AI web application for intelligent screening and triage of diabetic foot ulcers. Leverages state-of-the-art deep learning models for infection detection, ischemia assessment, and automated wound measurement, providing evidence-based clinical decision support for rural healthcare workers and patients.
longDescription:
**DERMA-DFU.ID** is an advanced healthcare platform designed to transform diabetic foot ulcer management through artificial intelligence. Built for resource-constrained settings, it empowers frontline healthcare workers and diabetes patients with instant, evidence-based triage capabilities.

The system performs multi-modal AI analysis combining **Classification** and **Segmentation**:
1. **4-Class Deep Learning Classifier**: Detects None, Infection, Ischaemia, or Both conditions using a custom-trained EfficientNet-style CNN model.
2. **U-Net Wound Segmentation**: Automatically measures wound area in pixels and converts to cm² using calibrated scale measurements.
3. **Clinical Rule Engine**: Integrates AI predictions with critical clinical signs (fever, pulse, odor, pain) to generate safety-first triage decisions.

**The Triage System (RED-YELLOW-GREEN)**:
- **RED (≤48h Referral)**: Danger signs detected (fever, spreading redness, no pulse, severe kidney disease + infection) OR high ischaemia probability OR AI detects "Both" conditions.
- **YELLOW (≤72h Tele-consult)**: Small wound with stable vitals OR mild infection/ischaemia detected by AI.
- **GREEN (Self-care + Education)**: Pre-ulcer stage or minimal wound with no concerning features.

**Key Technical Innovations**:
- **100% Client-Side AI Inference**: All ML models run in-browser via ONNX Runtime WebAssembly—no patient data ever leaves the device, ensuring HIPAA-level privacy.
- **Interactive Calibration System**: Two-point click measurement on ruler/card images for precise wound size calculation (mm/px scaling).
- **Comprehensive Dashboard Analytics**: Performance indicators including time-to-referral, completion rates, photo adherence, and triage distribution.
- **Tele-referral Integration**: Direct scheduling with specialists, real-time chat with doctors, and full digital health record management.

The application features a responsive React UI with dark mode, bilingual support (Indonesian/English), offline-capable PWA architecture, and Supabase backend with Row-Level Security for multi-tenant patient management.

title: River Gauge AI | Intelligent Water Level Monitoring System
description: A production-grade computer vision system for automated hydrological monitoring. Leverages YOLOv8 object detection to identify and read water gauge markings from RTSP video streams or uploaded footage. Features intelligent waterline detection using texture analysis and robust tick fitting algorithms, with real-time alerting for critical water levels.
longDescription:
**River Gauge AI** is an enterprise-ready platform designed to automate the monitoring of water levels in rivers, dams, and reservoirs. It eliminates the need for manual gauge readings by providing 24/7 automated detection with visual verification.

The system processes video feeds (RTSP streams or uploaded files) and uses advanced computer vision to detect staff gauges, identify percentage tick marks, and measure the exact water surface level. Each reading is calibrated to real-world elevation values and compared against configurable Yellow/Red alert thresholds.

**The AI pipeline consists of four stages:**
1. **Object Detection**: YOLOv8 model trained to detect percentage ticks (0%, 10%, 20%...100%) and staff gauge boards
2. **ROI Extraction**: Automatically crops the region of interest around detected gauges with smart padding
3. **Waterline Detection**: Multi-algorithm approach combining texture energy analysis, gradient detection, and side-aware processing to identify the water surface
4. **Elevation Calculation**: Robust linear regression fitting with rate-limiting to prevent false spikes

**Key capabilities include:**
- **For Operators**: Real-time monitoring dashboard with live video feeds, configurable alert zones (Yellow/Red), and visual overlays showing detected ticks and water levels
- **For Analysts**: Historical data visualization with Chart.js, exportable reports, and video playback with synchronized data
- **For Engineers**: Multi-project management, custom calibration parameters (base elevation low/high), and RTSP stream integration

The application features a modern React dashboard with TypeScript, supporting multiple concurrent monitoring sites. The backend uses FastAPI with async processing, SQLAlchemy for persistence, and FFmpeg for video handling. The CV engine leverages OpenCV with optional OpenCL acceleration and supports both CPU and GPU (CUDA) inference.

**Advanced Features:**
- Rate-limiting algorithm to filter false readings (max cm/sec threshold)
- Smart ROI zoom with texture-aware waterline detection
- Hold-last-known-good fallback for temporary detection failures
- Alert level visualization with color-coded overlays (Green/Yellow/Red zones)
- Docker containerization with docker-compose orchestration

title: Product Demand Forecasting | LSTM Time Series Prediction
description: An advanced time series forecasting project that predicts weekly product demand across multiple sites using deep learning. The model employs LSTM neural networks built with TensorFlow/Keras to analyze historical sales data and generate accurate demand predictions for inventory optimization.
longDescription:
**Product Demand Forecasting** is a comprehensive machine learning solution designed to predict future product sales using time series analysis.

The system processes transactional data from 2,065 unique products across 5 different sites, spanning from August 2024 to July 2025 (approximately 11,917 transaction records). It transforms daily sales data into weekly aggregated forecasts to help businesses optimize inventory management and reduce stockouts.

**Technical Implementation:**
1. **Data Preprocessing**: Weekly aggregation, series filtering, outlier capping, log transformation, and standard scaling
2. **LSTM Architecture**: Global LSTM model with regularization techniques to prevent overfitting
3. **Training**: Custom callbacks including EarlyStopping and ReduceLROnPlateau for optimal convergence
4. **Evaluation**: Comprehensive metrics including RMSE, MAE, and integer-rounded predictions for practical business use
5. **Inference**: Production-ready inference pipeline for single product-site predictions

**Key capabilities include:**
- Multi-site, multi-product demand forecasting
- Handling of sparse and irregular time series data
- Robust preprocessing pipeline (capping, log transform, scaling)
- Weekly demand prediction with integer output for actionable insights
- Model persistence for deployment and batch inference
- Statistical analysis and visualization of demand patterns

The project uses LightGBM for feature engineering and TensorFlow for deep learning, delivering production-grade forecasts that support strategic business decisions.

title: Customer Segmentation using RFM Analysis | K-Means Clustering for Retail Marketing
description: An advanced customer segmentation project utilizing RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis combined with K-Means clustering to identify distinct customer groups for targeted retail marketing strategies. Built entirely with Python, Pandas, and Scikit-learn, this analysis processes over 1M transactions to segment 5,000+ customers into actionable marketing personas.
longDescription:
This comprehensive data science project demonstrates end-to-end customer segmentation using RFM analysis, a powerful technique in retail analytics for understanding customer behavior and value.

**The system implements a complete analytical pipeline:**
1. **Data Cleaning & Preprocessing**: Handles 1M+ transaction records, removes anomalies, filters out negative quantities and prices, and validates customer data
2. **RFM Feature Engineering**: Constructs Recency (days since last purchase), Frequency (total transactions), and Monetary (total spending) metrics for each customer
3. **Outlier Detection**: Applies IQR (Interquartile Range) method to remove statistical outliers and ensure robust clustering
4. **Log Transformation**: Normalizes skewed Frequency and Monetary distributions for better clustering performance
5. **K-Means Clustering**: Uses elbow method and silhouette analysis to determine optimal number of customer segments
6. **Customer Profiling**: Creates actionable marketing personas based on cluster characteristics

**Key Insights Generated:**
- Identifies high-value customers (Champions) for VIP treatment and loyalty programs
- Detects at-risk customers (Need Attention) for retention campaigns
- Segments new customers for onboarding strategies
- Finds dormant customers for re-engagement campaigns

The analysis reduces the customer base from 5,878 to 5,001 customers after outlier removal, with clustering performed on standardized RFM features. All visualizations use Matplotlib and Seaborn for professional data presentation.

title: Face Recognition Attendance System | Anti-Spoofing Security
description: An enterprise-grade automated attendance platform designed for universities and corporations. Leverages AI-powered face recognition with advanced anti-spoofing technology to provide secure, contactless, and instant verification. The system combines YOLOv11 for face detection and InsightFace for recognition, featuring active liveness detection to prevent photo and video replay attacks.
longDescription:
**Face Recognition Attendance System** is a comprehensive platform that modernizes classroom and organizational attendance through state-of-the-art AI technology.

At its core is a powerful **Anti-Spoofing Engine** that analyzes texture patterns (LBP), motion, color distribution, and moire artifacts to differentiate real faces from photos or digital screens. This ensures the highest integrity of attendance records.

**The system features a dual-stage AI pipeline:**
1. **Detection & Liveness Verification**: YOLOv11-Face detects faces and custom CV algorithms verify liveness through micro-movement analysis (blinking, breathing) and texture analysis before processing.
2. **Face Recognition**: InsightFace (ArcFace) extracts 512-dimensional vector embeddings and matches them against the database using cosine similarity for high-confidence identification.

**Key capabilities include:**
- **For Lecturers**: Live attendance feed with real-time visual feedback, class scheduling, student enrollment management, and automated attendance reports.
- **For Administrators**: Centralized user management, system analytics, performance monitoring, and secure biometric data management.
- **Security Features**: Multi-layer anti-spoofing (texture, motion, depth analysis), encrypted face embeddings, and audit logging.

The application features a modern, responsive React UI with premium design, real-time WebSocket updates, and comprehensive admin dashboards. The backend uses Flask with SQLAlchemy for robust data persistence.

The platform solves the fundamental problem of "How will this color look on my nails?" by combining state-of-the-art computer vision with stunning WebGL rendering to deliver instant, realistic previews.

title: Multimodal Emotion Classification | Building and Comparing Unimodal vs Multimodal Approach
description: A comprehensive deep learning project comparing the performance of unimodal (text-only, image-only) versus multimodal (text + image) models for emotion classification. Features advanced techniques including OCR fusion, feature gating, and contrastive learning to classify 7 emotion categories with high accuracy.
longDescription:
**Multimodal Emotion Classification** is an advanced machine learning system that explores the effectiveness of combining multiple modalities (text and images) for emotion detection compared to single-modality approaches.

The system classifies content into **7 emotion categories**: Anger, Fear, Happiness, Hate, Love, Sorrow, and Surprise, using a sophisticated hybrid architecture.

**Key capabilities include:**

1. **Unimodal Models**:
   - **Text-Only**: RoBERTa-large based classifier with text masking and label smoothing (F1: 91.21%)
   - **Image-Only**: ResNet50 with ImageNet pre-training and data augmentation (F1: 87.07%)

2. **Multimodal Fusion**:
   - Late fusion with learnable gating mechanism
   - Feature-level alignment using contrastive loss (InfoNCE)
   - Modality dropout for robustness (20% for both text and image)
   - Achieves superior performance (F1: 92.30%) by leveraging complementary information

3. **Advanced Techniques**:
   - **OCR Integration**: Tesseract-based text extraction from images, fused with caption text
   - **Cross-Modal Alignment**: Contrastive learning to align text and image representations
   - **Class Imbalance Handling**: Weighted sampling + Class-Balanced Focal Loss
   - **Stratified Group K-Fold**: Prevents data leakage from duplicate/similar captions

4. **Training Optimizations**:
   - Partial unfreezing (RoBERTa last 6 layers, ResNet layer3/layer4)
   - Differential learning rates (2e-5 for backbone, 6e-5 for heads)
   - Gradient clipping and AMP for stable training
   - Cosine annealing LR schedule with warmup

The project demonstrates that multimodal models outperform unimodal counterparts by 1-5% F1 score, validating the benefit of cross-modal learning for emotion recognition tasks.

description: An enterprise-grade AI platform for automated civil infrastructure inspection. Leverages advanced Computer Vision to detect, classify, and assess the severity of 5 types of structural defects in concrete columns. Designed for civil engineers and inspectors to transform manual visual inspections into digital, auditable, and quantifiable workflows.
longDescription:
**Concrete Defect Detection** is a comprehensive structural health monitoring system built for the construction and civil engineering industries. It automates the inspection process for concrete infrastructure, providing rapid and accurate defect analysis.

The platform identifies **5 critical damage types**: Crack, Spalling, Honeycomb, Segregation, and Corrosion. Each detection is automatically classified by severity (Minor, Moderate, Severe) based on damage area ratios and visual characteristics.

**Key capabilities include:**
1. **Multi-Class Detection**: High-precision YOLO/CNN model optimized with ONNX Runtime for CPU inference
2. **Severity Assessment**: Intelligent severity grading using area analysis and damage-specific thresholds
3. **Smart Recommendations**: ISO/ACI-compliant repair solutions based on damage type and severity
4. **BIM Integration**: Exports IFC Overlay JSON for seamless integration with Autodesk Revit/Dynamo
5. **History & Analytics**: Tracks defect progression over time with filtering and analytics dashboard

The system features a fully responsive React UI with stunning visual design, dark mode, and interactive data cards powered by Framer Motion. The backend uses FastAPI for high-performance async inference.
features: Multi-Class Defect Detection (5 Damage Types)
Intelligent Severity Grading (Minor/Moderate/Severe)

title: StockAI - IDX Prediction Platform | AI-Powered Stock Market Analysis
description: An enterprise-grade financial analytics platform for predicting stock movements on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX). Combines Machine Learning with Bandar Analysis (Broker Accumulation) to identify high-probability trading signals. Designed for traders and analysts to transform raw stock data into actionable insights through a modern, responsive dashboard.
longDescription:
**StockAI** is a comprehensive stock market intelligence system built for the Indonesian financial market. It automates the analysis of daily market snapshots, broker activities, and technical indicators to generate actionable trading signals.

The platform processes daily market data and analyzes broker accumulation patterns ("Bandarology") to detect smart money movements. Each stock is assigned a Machine Learning probability score indicating the likelihood of price increases, combined with automated explanation generation.

**Key capabilities include:**
1. **Smart Signal Detection**: Automatically identifies stocks with BUY or STRONG SELL signals based on ML probability and technical indicators
2. **Bandar Accumulation Analysis**: Visualizes top buyer concentration to detect institutional money movements
3. **ML Probability Scoring**: XGBoost/Sklearn-powered inference engine assigns `prob_up` scores to every stock
4. **Backtesting Engine**: Verify strategy performance against historical data with customizable date ranges
5. **Real-time Filtering**: Filter opportunities by Threshold %, Broker, Price Range, and Signal Type
6. **Automated Explanations**: Human-readable reasons for every signal (e.g., "Volume sangat padat", "Ada dominasi Broker X")

The system features a fully responsive React UI with modern design, dark mode support, and real-time data tables. The backend uses FastAPI for high-performance async API serving with NaN/Inf-safe JSON responses.

title: cGAN & VGG16 for Scalp Disorder Classification
description: A multi-class image classification system combining Conditional GAN for synthetic data generation and VGG16-style architecture for medical image classification of scalp disorders. Built from scratch using TensorFlow/Keras and PyTorch for data augmentation through generative modeling.
longDescription:
This project tackles the challenge of medical image classification for scalp disorders using a two-stage deep learning pipeline:

**1. Synthetic Data Generation (cGAN):**
- Developed a Conditional GAN using PyTorch to address class imbalance
- Generates synthetic scalp disorder images conditioned on 12 different classes
- Produces 200 synthetic images per class for data augmentation
- Uses 64x64 image resolution with 100-dimensional latent space
- Trained for 50 epochs using Adam optimizer with custom learning rates

**2. Classification Model (VGG16):**
- Custom VGG16-style CNN architecture built with TensorFlow/Keras
- Multi-class classification across 12 scalp disorder categories
- Input resolution: 224x224 RGB images
- Includes data augmentation pipeline using ImageDataGenerator
- Comprehensive evaluation with classification reports and confusion matrices

**Classes Classified:**
Normal, Ketombe (Dandruff), Alopecia, Skin Inflammation, Folliculitis, Lichen Planus, Male Pattern Baldness, Psoriasis, Seborrheic Dermatitis, Telogen Effluvium, Tinea Capitis, and Head Lice.

**Technical Highlights:**
- Hybrid PyTorch (GAN) and TensorFlow (CNN) implementation
- Complete training pipeline with early stopping and model checkpointing
- Reproducible results with fixed random seeds
- Extensive EDA with class distribution analysis and sample visualizations
- Model persistence for inference and deployment

title: Enterprise PPE Detection VMS | AI Video Management SaaS Platform
description: A cloud-connected enterprise Video Management System for industrial health & safety compliance. It extends an on-premise YOLOv8 PPE-detection desktop app with a full B2B SaaS layer: a Next.js dashboard, hardware-locked licensing, live multi-camera WebRTC streaming, and automated incident management. Built for a petroleum services company to monitor PPE compliance across multiple sites.
longDescription:
This project transforms an on-premise computer-vision tool into a cloud-connected, multi-tenant SaaS product for industrial occupational health & safety (K3) compliance.

**Architecture**
The system follows an edge-to-cloud design:
- **Edge (on-premise):** A Python/PySide6 desktop app runs YOLOv8 inference on live RTSP camera feeds, detecting PPE violations (helmet, vest, gloves, glasses, shoes, mask). A hardware-lock module (Ed25519 cryptographic signature + MAC/CPU fingerprint) prevents unauthorized deployment.
- **Cloud VPS:** A Go2RTC media server handles RTSP-to-WebRTC transcoding for the live grid player. Caddy provides automatic TLS, and systemd units make the infrastructure reproducible.
- **Web Dashboard (Next.js 14):** A full admin panel covering live monitoring (1/4/9-camera grid), incident timeline, analytics (KPI cards, time-series charts, violation breakdown), camera management, and a licensing portal.
- **Supabase:** Multi-tenant Postgres with Row Level Security, Auth with custom JWT claims, Realtime for push config updates to desktops, Storage for incident snapshots, and Deno Edge Functions for license activation.

**Delivered across four milestones:**
1. Foundation & Licensing Core — Supabase schema, auth, SN inventory API, Ed25519 license signing.
2. Live Streaming & Remote Config — Go2RTC + WebRTC player, remote detection config via Supabase Realtime.
3. Dashboard & Analytics — Incident upload pipeline, KPI dashboard, time-series charts.
4. Incident Management & Deployment — Open→Reviewed→Resolved workflow, Excel export, UAT, and production VPS deployment.
features: Multi-camera live monitoring with 1/4/9-view WebRTC grid player streamed from on-premise RTSP cameras via Go2RTC
Cryptographic hardware-locked licensing (Ed25519 signature + CPU/MAC fingerprint) with online heartbeat and offline grace period

title: Mokapos to WhatsApp Automation | Daily Sales Reporting & Customer Campaigns
description: An n8n-based automation suite that integrates the Mokapos POS API with WhatsApp to eliminate manual daily reporting for a bakery franchise. Every night it fetches per-outlet revenue from the Mokapos API, formats a consolidated report, backs it up to Google Sheets, and delivers it to the owner via WhatsApp — fully unattended. Two extra workflows handle birthday greetings and promotional blasts.
longDescription:
This project solves a common small-business pain point: managers at a bakery chain with 8–10 outlets were manually compiling daily revenue reports from the Mokapos back-office each evening. The new system makes this fully automatic.

**Workflow 1 — Automated Daily Revenue Report**
n8n triggers at 23:00 WIB each night:
1. Calls the Mokapos API to fetch all active outlet IDs.
2. A Code node queries each outlet's daily revenue summary in parallel (OAuth2 access token with auto-refresh).
3. Aggregates and formats the data into a clean, human-readable WhatsApp message.
4. Writes a backup row to Google Sheets for historical record-keeping.
5. Delivers the message to the owner's WhatsApp via a self-hosted gateway with a human-like delay.

**Workflow 2 — Birthday Greeting Automation**
Pulls customers whose birthdays fall on the current date from Google Sheets, personalizes a greeting message, and sends it via WhatsApp with an optional promotional image.

**Workflow 3 — Promotional Blast**
Lets the owner trigger mass promotional messages (text + image) to segmented customer lists directly from Google Sheets via a single WhatsApp command.

The Mokapos OAuth2 integration required careful scope management and token refresh logic, all documented in a setup guide delivered to the client.

title: AI Patient Journey Automation | Medical Tourism Clinic Platform
description: A large-scale n8n automation platform that orchestrates the entire patient acquisition and clinical pipeline for a cosmetic surgery clinic. It handles inbound WhatsApp leads from Meta Ads, drives patients through a multi-stage AI-managed funnel (qualification, consultation, medical intake, lab review, treatment proposal, payment, surgery scheduling, post-op recovery), and uses LangChain AI agents with a pgvector RAG knowledge base for bilingual communication.
longDescription:
This is a production-grade patient journey automation platform built for a cosmetic surgery clinic catering to international medical tourism. It replaces a manual WhatsApp-based sales and clinical coordination process with a fully automated, AI-driven system comprising 54 active n8n workflows across 7 functional layers.

**Core Architecture**
All inbound WhatsApp messages route through the main Conversation Agent — a LangChain-powered AI agent with tools for RAG knowledge base search, lead qualification, Gmail sending, and Google Calendar management. Patient state is persisted in PostgreSQL, and each stage transition triggers a dedicated webhook-based sub-workflow.

**Patient Funnel (Stages 10–17)**
- **Medical Intake:** Sends a Google Form/Tally link; a nudge cron checks completion; submitted responses are parsed and saved.
- **Lab Review:** Gemini Vision parses uploaded lab PDFs, compares values against reference ranges, and flags abnormalities for doctor approval.
- **Treatment Proposal:** Auto-generates a bilingual PDF proposal via Google Docs template; sends via WhatsApp + Gmail; follow-up cron runs at D+2 and D+5.
- **Deposit Payment:** Creates a Xendit invoice, sends the link, and runs a progressive reminder cron (24h/48h/72h).
- **Surgery Scheduling:** Books a surgery slot in Google Calendar and sends a pre-op confirmation.
- **Recovery:** Post-op check-in messages at D+1, D+3, D+7, D+15, D+30, and D+90, with a Red Flag Escalation sub-workflow for emergencies.

**Cross-Cutting Infrastructure**
RAG knowledge base (pgvector + OpenAI embeddings), OpenAI Vision photo analysis, Whisper voice-note transcription, an Emergency Classifier, a Dead-Letter Queue retry worker, and a Health Check Monitor.
features: LangChain AI conversation agent handling full patient qualification and bilingual WhatsApp communication across 54 n8n workflows
RAG knowledge base (pgvector + OpenAI embeddings) enabling AI-grounded answers about clinic procedures, pricing, and FAQs

title: Odoo × Shopee Integration | Automated E-Commerce Sync
description: A full bidirectional integration between Odoo 17 (ERP) and the Shopee Open Platform for a fashion retail business. The system automates product and stock synchronization, order ingestion, and variant management so the merchant never manages two systems manually. Built entirely on n8n workflows deployed alongside Odoo via Docker.
longDescription:
Managing inventory across an offline ERP and an online marketplace is a constant source of human error — overselling, stale listings, and missed orders. This project eliminates that friction by making Odoo 17 the single source of truth and letting n8n act as the middleware that keeps Shopee in sync.

**Architecture overview:**
- Odoo 17 (self-hosted on VPS, Docker) serves as the master data store for products, stock levels, and sales orders.
- n8n (deployed in the same Docker network) handles all API orchestration.
- The Shopee Open Platform V2 API is authenticated via HMAC-SHA256 signed OAuth2 tokens, with a dedicated auto-refresh workflow on a cron schedule so the integration never goes stale.

**Five core workflow modules:**
1. **Token Auto-Refresher** — keeps the Shopee access token alive automatically.
2. **Product Push** — publishes new products (name, price, description, images, variants) from Odoo to Shopee listings.
3. **Variant & Stock Sync** — bidirectional stock updates: Odoo-to-Shopee on any manual adjustment, and Shopee-to-Odoo whenever an online order is placed.
4. **Order Webhook** — listens for Shopee order push events and automatically creates a Sales Order in Odoo with full customer and product mapping.
5. **Fulfillment** — propagates shipping tracking numbers back to Shopee after the warehouse team updates the delivery in Odoo.

The project also includes an error-alert mechanism, category-to-attribute mapping guides, and full handover documentation.

title: Spray Injector Nozzle AI Inspector | Computer Vision Quality Control
description: A Computer Vision system built for a quality-control team to automatically measure four geometric spray attributes and classify the condition of fuel injector nozzles (Normal / Repair / Replace) in real time. It replaces subjective manual inspection with a consistent, AI-driven pipeline running on a Raspberry Pi 5, eliminating operator variability on the test bench.
longDescription:
Manual inspection of injector nozzle spray patterns is inherently subjective — two operators examining the same test image can reach different conclusions, creating inconsistent QC records. This project provides an objective, fully automated alternative.

**How it works:**
A camera captures frames from the spray test rig. The OpenCV-based CV pipeline segments the spray region, detects contours, and computes four geometric attributes on every frame:
1. **Spray Length** — distance from nozzle tip to the farthest spray endpoint.
2. **Spray Width** — maximum lateral spread of the spray pattern.
3. **Spray Angle** — opening angle of each stream from the nozzle center.
4. **Symmetry Index** — balance score between left and right spray arms.

A TensorFlow/Keras classifier (trained on 520 labeled images) takes those geometric features plus the cropped spray image and outputs one of three condition labels with a confidence score.

**Desktop application (PyQt5):**
A full-featured GUI provides a live camera feed with overlay annotations, ROI configuration, one-click pixel-to-mm calibration, and an export function that writes per-inspection results (geometry values + AI label + capture photo) to a timestamped CSV report.

The system runs entirely offline on a Raspberry Pi 5, with no cloud dependency.
features: Real-time automated measurement of 4 spray geometry attributes (length, width, angle, symmetry) per frame
AI classification of nozzle condition into 3 labels — Normal, Repair, Replace — with a confidence score
Interactive ROI and pixel-to-mm calibration tool for one-time physical setup
PyQt5 desktop GUI with a live annotated video feed and per-inspection capture
CSV and photo export of every inspection result for QC record-keeping and audit trails

title: AI Camera Activity Recognition System | Multi-Object & Human Activity Detection
description: A real-time AI camera system that detects multiple object categories (humans, animals, heavy equipment, everyday items) and recognizes a wide spectrum of human activities and facial expressions using YOLO-based pose estimation and a temporal action classifier. The desktop application targets use cases such as homecare monitoring and restaurant staff supervision, running fully offline with a SQLite activity log.
longDescription:
Generic CCTV footage requires a human watcher — this project turns any camera feed into an autonomous monitor that understands *what is happening*, not just that something is there.

**Detection capabilities:**
- **Object categories:** humans, animals (cat, dog, cow, sheep), heavy machinery (excavator, truck), and common objects with counting.
- **Human activities:** standing, sitting, falling, cooking, carrying items, eating/drinking, talking, cashier posture, running, carrying a baby, violence detection, and sleeping.
- **Facial expressions:** smiling, laughing, frowning, sadness (via MediaPipe FaceLandmarker).
- **Animal activities:** sleeping, eating, walking.

**Technical architecture:**
A unified YOLO pose model outputs both bounding boxes and skeletal keypoints in a single forward pass. A secondary temporal model (LSTM / ST-GCN) analyses a rolling 30-frame keypoint buffer per tracked identity to classify complex sequential actions. ByteTrack provides stable per-ID tracking across frames, enabling a **Lock Target** feature that keeps focus on a specific individual through occlusion.

**Application modes:**
- *All Mode* — full detection.
- *Homecare Mode* — focuses on violence, fall, and baby-carrying detection.
- *Restaurant Mode* — focuses on cooking, serving, and cashier posture.

All detected events are logged to a local SQLite database with timestamps, enabling daily activity reports without any internet connection.
features: Real-time detection of humans, animals, heavy machinery, and common objects across multiple camera feeds
Human activity recognition for 13+ activity classes using temporal pose-keypoint analysis (LSTM/ST-GCN)
Facial expression recognition (smile, laugh, frown, sadness) via MediaPipe FaceLandmarker
Lock Target feature for stable single-individual tracking through occlusion using ByteTrack
Per-camera configurable detection modes (All / Homecare / Restaurant) with SQLite activity logging

title: AI Sales Automation Agent | Smart Follow-Up, Lead Scoring & CRM
description: An intelligent sales automation system built on n8n for a vehicle paint-protection film (PPF) and vinyl-wrap installer. The system extends an existing Instagram DM AI chatbot with a context-aware follow-up engine, automated lead classification (HOT / WARM / COLD), a Google Sheets CRM that captures customer data and financials, and automatic invoice dispatch — all without manual intervention from the sales team.
longDescription:
The client already had an AI chatbot responding to Instagram DM inquiries automatically, but the follow-up layer was unintelligent — it had no memory of how many times it had messaged a lead and could not distinguish a serious buyer from a ghost. This project added the intelligence layer on top.

**Three workflow modules:**

1. **Smart Follow-Up + Auto Labeling** — A cron-based n8n workflow checks every lead's last response time and fires follow-up messages at configurable intervals (default: 8h → 16h → 23h). Claude generates each message with full conversation context so each follow-up feels natural and escalates in urgency. After 3 unanswered follow-ups the lead is automatically marked as junk. Active leads are scored HOT or WARM based on AI sentiment analysis of their replies.

2. **Google Sheets CRM + Auto Invoice** — Every new lead and interaction is upserted (no duplicates) into a structured Google Sheets database (customer name, WhatsApp number, location, referral source, product interest, follow-up count, lead label, financial data). Invoice PDFs are generated and dispatched automatically to the customer's WhatsApp or email upon closing.

3. **WhatsApp Integration (Phase 2)** — The same follow-up and CRM workflows are replicated for the WhatsApp Business API channel, giving the client a unified pipeline across both Instagram DM and WhatsApp.
features: Context-aware auto follow-up engine with 3-stage escalation (8h, 16h, 23h) and automatic lead disqualification after no response
AI-powered lead scoring that classifies every lead as HOT, WARM, or COLD based on Claude sentiment analysis of conversation history
Automated Google Sheets CRM upsert — every new lead and status change is recorded without duplicates
Automatic invoice generation and dispatch to customer WhatsApp or email upon order confirmation
Dual-channel coverage: identical workflows running in parallel for both Instagram DM and WhatsApp Business

title: WhatsApp AI Sales Chatbot + Odoo ERP | End-to-End Order Automation
description: A full-stack sales automation solution combining a WhatsApp AI chatbot (built on n8n) with a freshly implemented Odoo ERP backend for a medical equipment and supplies distributor. The AI agent handles customer identification, product catalog browsing, order creation, proforma invoice dispatch, and admin escalation — turning WhatsApp into a low-effort sales channel backed by a real ERP.
longDescription:
The client wanted to handle sales inquiries, catalog requests, and order placement entirely through WhatsApp, with all transactions recorded automatically in a proper ERP system. This project delivered both layers as an integrated solution.

**Odoo ERP implementation:**
Odoo was installed from scratch and configured with Sales, Inventory, Invoicing, and CRM modules. Custom fields were added to products and customers specifically to support chatbot integration — allowing the bot to look up stock, pricing, and customer history via Odoo's API.

**WhatsApp AI Agent (n8n):**
Seven n8n workflows power the chatbot:
1. **Main Agent** — receives incoming WhatsApp messages via webhook, runs the AI conversation loop, and dispatches replies.
2. **Send Catalog** — sends a product catalog to the customer in text or image format on demand.
3. **Create Order** — creates a confirmed Sales Order in Odoo with full line-item detail after the customer explicitly confirms.
4. **Send Invoice** — dispatches a proforma invoice after order creation, and a final invoice after payment confirmation.
5. **Admin Escalation** — hands off the conversation to a human admin for closing, complaints, or out-of-scope questions, with a full order summary.
6. **24-Hour Payment Reminder** — sends an automatic reminder if a proforma invoice goes unpaid.
7. **12-Hour Lead Follow-up** — re-engages leads that browsed the catalog but never placed an order.

The system prompt enforces a strict flow: greet → identify customer → help select products → confirm order → create order + invoice → escalate to admin for payment verification.
features: WhatsApp AI agent that handles the full sales cycle: customer identification, catalog browsing, order confirmation, and invoice dispatch
Automatic Sales Order creation in Odoo via API immediately after the customer confirms their basket
Dual-invoice flow: proforma sent automatically at order creation, final invoice sent after payment confirmation
Scheduled follow-up workflows: 24-hour payment reminder and 12-hour lead re-engagement for cart abandoners
Smart admin escalation with a full order summary for closing, complaints, and COD confirmation

title: JerseyGen | AI-Powered Football Jersey Design Studio
description: A Next.js web application that lets users design custom football and futsal jerseys with a real-time 3D preview, then uses an AI image-generation API to produce a photorealistic render of a person wearing the customized jersey. Users can design patterns, colors, text, and logos, optionally upload their own face photo, and download or print the final design sheet.
longDescription:
JerseyGen is a full-featured jersey customization web app built for a sports apparel business. The core experience is a real-time 3D jersey viewer — users can rotate the model 360°, choose from preset or uploaded patterns, configure primary/secondary/accent colors, add sponsor text, player names, and numbers, and upload custom logos.

Once satisfied with the design, users can optionally upload a photo of their own face. The app then calls an AI image-editing API which composites the custom jersey design onto an AI-generated person, preserving facial likeness.

**Key capabilities:**
- Real-time 3D jersey preview built with Three.js / react-three-fiber
- Pattern presets (stripes, chevron, two-tone, diagonal) plus user-uploaded patterns with recoloring
- Text layer: player name, number, sponsor, and free-form text on front and back
- Logo upload with placement controls
- Face-swap mode: upload your own photo → AI generates you wearing the jersey
- Save up to 20 designs locally (localStorage) and reload them by name
- Export: download a PNG design sheet (front + back views) or print directly

The AI backend is provider-agnostic — it supports multiple image-edit models and a mock mode for UI testing.
features: Interactive 3D jersey viewer with 360° rotation and zoom
Full design editor: patterns, colors, text (name/number/sponsor), and logo upload
AI face-swap: upload your face photo and see yourself wearing the custom jersey
Save and reload up to 20 named designs via browser localStorage
One-click PNG export and print layout for front and back views

title: MDCNN News Text Classifier | Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation
description: A research replication project implementing the MDCNN (Multi-Teacher Distillation-Based CNN) architecture from a 2025 IEEE Access paper. The model combines BERT and BiGRU as teacher models to train a lightweight TextCNN student via knowledge distillation, achieving near-BERT accuracy on the AG News classification benchmark at a fraction of the model size.
longDescription:
This project was built for a graduate thesis student who needed a clean, reproducible implementation of the MDCNN paper (IEEE Access, 2025) to support their academic research.

The pipeline implements three models in a unified Jupyter Notebook:

1. **Teacher 1 — BERT:** Fine-tuned `bert-base-uncased` for 4-class news categorization (World, Sports, Business, Sci/Tech) on the AG News dataset.
2. **Teacher 2 — BiGRU:** A bidirectional GRU trained on the same data using a learned vocabulary.
3. **Student — TextCNN (MDCNN):** A lightweight convolutional text classifier trained with a dual-teacher knowledge distillation loss.

The distillation loss uses loss-guided adaptive weighting to dynamically balance teacher contributions, with a final KL-divergence distillation term using the optimal parameters from the paper (α=0.3, τ=5).

The deliverable is a single self-contained, Colab-ready notebook with markdown explanations, reproducible 8:1:1 splits, and a final comparison table (TextCNN baseline vs MDCNN) reproducing the paper's reported metrics (~91.7% accuracy / F1 on AG News).
features: Full MDCNN pipeline: BERT teacher, BiGRU teacher, and TextCNN student in one notebook
Loss-guided adaptive weighting for dynamic teacher contribution balancing
Knowledge distillation with KL-divergence loss (α=0.3, τ=5 per paper)
AG News dataset with an 8:1:1 train/val/test split matching the paper's methodology
Comparison table — TextCNN baseline vs MDCNN — showing the distillation improvement

title: Ad Performance Monitor & AI Advisor | Multi-Channel ROAS Automation
description: A self-hosted automation system that pulls daily advertising data from Meta Ads, Shopee, and TikTok Shop, calculates ROAS and key metrics, and delivers AI-generated optimization recommendations to a Telegram group. It combines n8n for workflow orchestration with an AI agent for conversational advisory and long-term memory.
longDescription:
This project addresses a common pain point for e-commerce advertisers: manually checking ROAS across multiple ad platforms every day and making data-driven decisions without expert guidance. The system automates the entire monitoring loop.

**Architecture (self-hosted on VPS):**
- **n8n** handles all technical execution: cron scheduling, parallel API calls to the Meta Marketing API, Shopee Open Platform, and TikTok Shop Partner API, metric calculation, and Telegram message delivery.
- An **AI agent** handles the intelligence layer: LLM-based analysis, optimization recommendations, conversational reply handling when team members respond in the Telegram group, and persistent memory of past recommendations.

**Daily flow:**
1. An n8n cron triggers at 08:00 WIB and reads ROAS thresholds from a Google Sheets config.
2. Data is fetched from all three ad platforms in parallel.
3. Six key metrics are calculated (ROAS, Spend, Revenue, CPA, CTR, Conversion Rate).
4. If ROAS falls below threshold, the AI agent is invoked to generate contextual recommendations across bidding strategy, budget reallocation, and creative.
5. A formatted message (metrics + AI advice) is sent to the advertiser team's Telegram group.
6. Team members can reply directly in Telegram; the agent maintains conversation context across sessions.

The design keeps LLM costs low by routing routine work through n8n (zero token cost) and only calling the AI model when ROAS is below threshold or when a team member starts a conversation.
features: Automated daily ROAS and metric collection from Meta Ads, Shopee, and TikTok Shop
AI-generated optimization recommendations triggered when ROAS drops below a configurable threshold
Telegram group notifications with formatted metrics and actionable AI advice
Two-way conversational AI in Telegram with persistent long-term memory
Google Sheets-based threshold configuration for non-technical team management

title: Fuel Supply Chain AI | Demand Forecasting & Distribution Optimizer
description: A Streamlit-based AI dashboard built for a fuel distribution terminal, covering demand forecasting for 135 retail stations over a 1–10 year horizon and a multi-agent AI architecture prototype. The system uses XGBoost and Prophet models with population and vehicle-growth factors, displays an interactive map, and includes a conversational LangChain AI assistant for supply chain queries.
longDescription:
This project tackles real operational challenges in fuel distribution: preventing shortages, optimizing truck dispatch, and planning terminal infrastructure capacity. Built under a formal contract (Phase 1), it processes shipment history from a terminal covering 135 retail fuel stations and 56 tanker trucks.

**Dashboard tabs:**
- **Terminal Overview** — an interactive Folium map of all 135 stations with delivery statistics, daily trend lines, and product composition charts.
- **Demand Forecasting** — XGBoost and Prophet models project demand 1–10 years out. Users can toggle between trip-count and volume views and switch between daily, monthly, and yearly granularity, incorporating external growth factors (population, registered vehicles). Results export to a 4-sheet Excel file.
- **AI Assistant** — a LangChain-powered chat interface answering natural-language queries about supply chain data (e.g., "How many loading bays will be needed if demand rises 15% next year?").

**Multi-Agent Architecture (roadmap):**
An Orchestrator Agent coordinates five specialist agents — Demand, Terminal, Distribution, Station, and Risk — each owning a different operational domain. Phase 1 delivered the Demand Agent prototype and the full data preprocessing pipeline.

**Data pipeline:** Raw shipment and station data → coordinate geocoding → daily aggregation per station per product → clean CSVs ready for modeling.
features: Interactive map of 135 fuel stations with delivery statistics and trip/volume metrics
XGBoost + Prophet demand forecasting up to 10 years with population and vehicle growth factors
Toggle between trip-count and volume views with daily/monthly/yearly granularity
Conversational LangChain AI assistant for natural-language supply chain queries
4-sheet Excel export: historical data, forecasts, per-station recap, and per-product recap
